Independent convolution-based distinct-summand checks gave correct exclusion/saturation for h=2,3,4,7,10,20,100,133,145, with independent raw greedy replay for h<=10. Distinguish finite consistency tests from the affine-stability proof of the entire infinite family; minimal difference period g+1, preperiod 2h+4 and density |R_h|/M=1/3 follow.
